name: Clithni
body:
Price 10,000 gp; Weight 1/2 lb.; Capacity —; Usage consumable

DESCRIPTION

This clear, emerald liquid, when ingested, causes the drinker to live several years longer. It makes the drinker more youthful by subtracting 1d10 years from the character’s current age. Penalties from aging can be reversed by this effect, but bonuses are not lost.

Sandy Petersen’s Cthulhu Mythos, © 2017, Petersen Games; Authors: Sandy Petersen, Arthur Petersen, Ian Starcher.
